content.text: {"problem": {"theorem": "证明若实数 a<b，则 a^3<b^3。", "assumptions": ["a,b 为实数，且 a<b。"], "domain": "elementary_algebra", "explicit_subgoals": []}, "target": {"node_id": "n1", "version": 1}, "target_node": {"text": "由 a<b 可知 a^2<b^2。", "claim": "由假设 a<b 推出 a^2<b^2。", "scope": [], "depends_on": [], "goal_refs": []}, "closed_predecessors": [], "patch": {"base_state_digest": "d609c0e3dfc5c88e8986a3d75281d3b79af3998ae77e6de87af7bdc7263cc4ba", "certificate_id": "3cab86fb9d7229ed15591ff3d1f32b787e3c02f3fcf926a30618f9e492601ea3", "target": {"node_id": "n1", "version": 1}, "operation": "replace", "nodes": [{"node_id": "n1", "text": "因为 a<b，所以 b-a>0。又有 a^2+ab+b^2=3(a+b)^2/4+(a-b)^2/4>0，其中严格大于零是因为 a-b≠0。因此 b^3-a^3=(b-a)(a^2+ab+b^2)>0，故 a^3<b^3。", "claim": "若实数 a<b，则 a^3<b^3。", "depends_on": [], "scope": [], "goal_refs": []}], "target_dependencies_after": [], "counterexample": null, "reason": "原节点错误地使用了平方函数在全体实数上严格递增这一不成立的性质；改用立方差分解，并证明两个因子均为正，可直接得到原定理。"}, "patch_digest": "44eef9937ee10478d4bd0f20eaa5f32f74bfccc3116cc3b7eade8a0988a62ef8", "certificate": {"certificate_id": "3cab86fb9d7229ed15591ff3d1f32b787e3c02f3fcf926a30618f9e492601ea3", "problem_digest": "2399eaff069d3e5e16d7131419ca75dfaab9c0a599af4b3def286425b0ed8c3e", "target": {"node_id": "n1", "version": 1}, "graph_digest": "26514b6cf737ef1cd03e86a14438c831674c1989949d3678baf170d75c9adae6", "confirmation": "confirmed", "kind": "invalid", "failed_edge": "从 a<b 推出 a^2<b^2。", "quote": "由 a<b 可知 a^2<b^2。", "reason": "该推论在实数域中不成立，因为平方函数并非在全体实数上严格递增。例如取 a=-2、b=-1，则 a<b，但 a^2=4>1=b^2。"}, "proposed_proof": "因为 a<b，所以 b-a>0。又有 a^2+ab+b^2=3(a+b)^2/4+(a-b)^2/4>0，其中严格大于零是因为 a-b≠0。因此 b^3-a^3=(b-a)(a^2+ab+b^2)>0，故 a^3<b^3。\n再分别乘以 a 和 b，得到 a^3<b^3。\n因此立方函数严格递增。"}
